name: Previous Candle Breakdown
summary: This EA trades breakouts of the previous candle's high and low. When price breaks above the previous candle's high, it opens a buy; when price breaks below the previous candle's low, it opens a sell. It is a simple structural breakout system that relies on momentum continuation after a range expansion.
summary_zh: 该EA基于前一根K线的高低点突破进行交易。价格突破前一根K线高点时开多单，突破前一根K线低点时开空单。这是一个简单的结构性突破系统，依赖区间扩展后的动量延续。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于前一根K线的结构突破，认为价格突破前一根K线的极值后会延续趋势方向。入场条件为：当当前价格突破前一根已完成K线的最高价时买入，当当前价格跌破前一根已完成K线的最低价时卖出。出场条件可能包括固定的止盈止损，或基于ATR的动态止损。仓位管理方面，EA可能使用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例仓位。资金管理方面，如果没有使用马丁格尔或网格策略，则风险相对可控，但需要关注连续假突破带来的连亏风险。该策略在趋势明确的市场中表现较好，但在震荡行情中容易因频繁假突破而亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on structural breakout of the previous candle, assuming that price continuation follows a breach of the prior candle's extremes. Entry conditions: buy when current price breaks above the previous completed candle's high, sell when current price breaks below the previous completed candle's low. Exit conditions likely include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, or possibly ATR-based dynamic stops. Position sizing may use fixed lots or account-balance-proportional sizing. Money management is moderately controlled if no martingale or grid is employed, but consecutive false breakouts in ranging markets can cause drawdowns. The strategy performs best in trending markets but suffers from frequent whipsaws during consolidation periods.

parameters.description_en: Initial lot size, martingale base quantity

parameters.name: StopLoss

parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, max loss per trade

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，0表示不设止盈
parameters.description_en: Group TP in points, close all at this profit

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于识别本EA的订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number to distinguish trade instances

parameters.name: CandleOffset
parameters.description: 前第N根K线作为突破参考
parameters.description_en: Nth previous bar as breakout reference

pros: 逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和验证
无需复杂指标，减少参数过拟合风险
在趋势行情中能及时捕捉突破机会
入场规则明确，不依赖主观判断
pros_en: Simple and clear logic, easy to understand and verify
No complex indicators needed, reducing overfitting risk
Captures breakout opportunities promptly in trending markets
Well-defined entry rules without subjective judgment
cons: 震荡行情中假突破频繁导致亏损
缺少趋势过滤器容易在盘整中反复开仓
固定止损止盈可能不适应不同市场波动率
未考虑交易时段和流动性差异
缺少仓位管理机制可能导致过度交易
cons_en: Frequent false breakouts in ranging markets lead to losses
Lacks trend filter, prone to repeated entries during consolidation
Fixed stop-loss/take-profit may not suit varying market volatility
Does not account for trading session and liquidity differences
Lack of position management may lead to overtrading
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如均线方向或ATR阈值）以过滤假突破
加入交易时段过滤，避开低流动性时段
使用ATR动态调整止损止盈以适应市场波动率
增加最大连续亏损次数限制和冷却期
加入仓位管理模块，根据账户风险比例动态调仓
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (e.g., MA direction or ATR threshold) to filter false breakouts
Add trading session filter to avoid low-liquidity periods
Use ATR-based dynamic stop-loss/take-profit to adapt to market volatility
Add maximum consecutive loss limit and cooldown period
Add position sizing module based on account risk percentage

risk_points: 缺少趋势过滤器导致震荡市频繁亏损
可能缺少新K线检查导致同一突破重复开仓
固定止损可能不适应当前市场波动率
risk_points_en: Lacks trend filter leading to frequent losses in ranging markets
May lack new bar check causing repeated entries on same breakout
Fixed stop-loss may not adapt to current market volatility
